verdict_a_product_behavior.root_cause_classification: This was not the prior viewport preflight defect and no product assertion failure was recorded. The hosted resource watchdog stopped the guest child when CPU busy/load crossed its safety boundary. A process attribution snapshot included Chromium processes and unrelated runner processes, so the evidence establishes a resource-invalid host interval but does not prove a single process caused it.
